definitions.gloss: the Three Views of Japan; Japan's three most scenic spots
definitions.explanation: The traditional set of Japan's three most celebrated landscapes: {松島|まつしま} in Miyagi, {天橋立|あまのはしだて} in Kyoto, and {宮島|みやじま} (Itsukushima) in Hiroshima. The grouping dates from the Edo period and is still used in tourism and school geography.

examples.japanese: {松島|まつしま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Matsushima is one of the Three Views of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Over the summer vacation I visited all three of the Three Views of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{宮島|みやじま}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えられている→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: Miyajima, famous for its torii gate that seems to float on the sea, is also counted among the Three Views of Japan.

notes:
{三景|さんけい} means "three views." Japanese likes such sets of three: {日本三名園|にほんさんめいえん} (the three great gardens) and {日本三大|にほんさんだい}〜 (Japan's three greatest ~) follow the same pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one of the Three Views of Japan
- {日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えられる→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to be counted among the Three Views
- {日本三景|にほんさんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧: to tour the Three Views

CULTURAL NOTE:
All three sites are coastal, combining sea, pine-covered islands or sandbars, and (at Miyajima) a shrine. Each sells itself as {日本三景|にほんさんけい}, and the phrase appears constantly in travel brochures.
